family: Zou-Fan-Gao-Wang f_m (arXiv 2608.30275), member f_M evaluated at order M

summary.note: Rigorous Arb enclosures. Every evaluated member is positive for 6<=M<=32 and certified negative for 33<=M<=400. Members with M divisible by 4 use the exact parameters a=2^(-M/4); others use a rational a within 1e-12 (still an admissible log-concave density). Orders >=165 not divisible by 4 were skipped (rational approximation underflow). The order-16 witness of this repo beats this family by 17 orders.
